scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm --dir apps/api install && pnpm --dir apps/web install
scripts.dev: pnpm --dir apps/web exec ng cache clean && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web "pnpm --dir apps/api run dev" "pnpm --dir apps/web run dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --dir apps/api run build && pnpm --dir apps/web run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir apps/api run typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/web run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --dir apps/api run test && pnpm --dir apps/web run test:ci
